findings.what: The TUI DAG page's mode line prints `ranks served` on the normal (model-served) path, while the model's own report says the ranks are DERIVED. The web's geometry reports derived=true for the same model, so the two planes describe one picture with two different provenances, and the TUI's word is the one that used to mean the untrusted served-depth fallback (R18).
findings.where: packages/mpd-tui-plugin/src/panel-dag.ts — the mode line (`ranks ${layout.ranksDerived ? "derived" : "served"}`) reading `dagPanelLayout`'s flag; `rankPlan(tasks, servedRanks)` returns `derived: false` by design when served ranks are applied.
findings.why: A reader is told the vertical order came from the degraded fallback when it came from the shared core's derivation. It is the R18 honesty rule inverted by the new input path.
findings.evidence: tui-result.json ranksSource={'layoutRanksDerived': False, 'modelRanksDerived': True, 'pageHasServedRanks': True}; compare-result.json tuiRanksEqualModel=True; web geometry publishes report.ranksDerived from served.report (team-view.ts).
findings.direction: Carry the model's `report.ranksDerived` into the page (or add a distinct `rankSource` value) and print THAT when page.ranks is present; keep `layout.ranksDerived` for the no-model path. Alternatively reword to distinguish `derived (host)` from `served depth`.

findings.what: The web factory still declares its own numeric id collator (`ID_ORDER`) for the within-column sort — a comparator, not a rank derivation; the risk is drift if the core's collator ever changes.
findings.where: packages/mpd-bundle-plugin/src/team-view.ts (one `Intl.Collator` declaration, one sort site); two occurrences in the built client.js.
findings.why: G1 forbids a third DERIVATION of ranks, which is gone; the duplicated comparator is the last small piece of the shared key that is not shared. Both planes sort by the same rule today.
findings.direction: Publish the order with the model (`ranks` already carries each bucket in id order) or splice the core's comparator the way the model itself is spliced; do not copy it again.

findings.direction: None required; recorded as pre-wave behaviour.
